name: Survive Nightmare Deer
desc:
You are not alone in this maze. A familiar, nightmarish deer hunts you down.

You must explore and wander the maze, collecting gems to increase your chances of survival for the next time you go down.

Explore endlessly through a maze while trying to run from an.. unusual deer
Can you survive?

Inspiration: 99 Nights in the Forest, Their game is super fun, check it out here: https://www.roblox.com/games/79546208627805/99-Nights-in-the-Forest
